stem.en: Is each statement true or false?

text.en: An app may save your chat even though the model's settings stay frozen.
A friend's photo is safe to paste into a chat, because the model is frozen.
Asking an app to explain fractions, then doing the sums yourself, is the same as handing in its answers.
Search results in the context window can still be wrong.

explanation.en: The model and the app are separate, so frozen settings say nothing about what the app keeps, and a friend's photo is not yours to share. An explanation leaves the thinking to you, which handed-in work does not. Pasted text is only text, so a wrong page gives the model wrong text.

hints.en: Keep the model and the app apart in your mind.
